name: CrowdStrike Falcon MCP Server
description: An MCP server that enables interaction with the CrowdStrike Falcon API for managing hosts, detections, IOCs, and security policies. It supports both STDIO and HTTP/REST transport modes for seamless integration with AI clients like Claude and Cursor.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server that enables interaction with the CrowdStrike Falcon API for managing hosts, detections, IOCs, and security policies. It supports both STDIO and HTTP/REST transport modes for seamless integration with AI clients like Claude and Cursor.

FALCON_API_KEY.description: Your CrowdStrike API key. Alternative to CROWDSTRIKE_API_KEY.

TRANSPORT_MODE.description: Transport mode - stdio, http, or dual (default: dual)

FALCON_TENANT_ID.description: Optional tenant ID for multi-tenant scenarios. Alternative to CROWDSTRIKE_TENANT_ID.

CROWDSTRIKE_API_KEY.description: Alternative environment variable for the CrowdStrike API key.

CROWDSTRIKE_TENANT_ID.description: Alternative environment variable for the CrowdStrike tenant ID.
